description: This file contains utility functions for managing task list items within the Notesnook project, including counting checked items, deleting checked items, sorting list items, finding root task lists, and toggling child task items.

methods.name: countCheckedItems
methods.description: Counts the number of checked and total task items within a given ProsemirrorNode.

methods.name: deleteCheckedItems
methods.description: Deletes checked task items from a transaction at a specified position.

methods.name: sortList
methods.description: Sorts task list items within a transaction based on their checked state.

methods.name: findRootTaskList
methods.description: Finds the closest parent task list node that is not nested within other task list or task item nodes.

methods.name: toggleChildren
methods.description: Toggles the checked state of all descendant task items within a node.
